summary:
Project TARAK is an interactive educational platform that brings the stories of NASA's forgotten space equipment back to life. Inspired by the challenge "Abandoned but Not Forgotten," TARAK allows students to explore spacecraft, rovers, landers, helicopters, and scientific instruments left behind on the Moon, Mars, and beyond.

The platform combines immersive 3D space exploration, interactive mission timelines, and AI-powered storytelling to explain the journeys, scientific achievements, and final destinations of these machines. Students can discover mission facts, interact with an AI space assistant, explore equipment, and learn through engaging educational experiences.

By transforming NASA's historical mission information into an accessible and interactive digital experience, TARAK aims to make space science more engaging for young learners while preserving the legacy of the machines that helped humanity explore the universe.
details:
Project TARAK – Project Details

Project TARAK is an interactive educational platform designed to preserve and share the stories of NASA's equipment left behind on the Moon, Mars, and other celestial destinations.

The platform allows students to explore different space missions, discover abandoned spacecraft and scientific equipment, understand their purposes, and learn about their scientific achievements through interactive mission timelines and storytelling.

Its key features include an interactive space exploration experience, a searchable mission library, detailed equipment profiles, and an AI-powered space assistant that explains mission histories and answers students' questions in simple, engaging language. The platform also aims to incorporate 3D equipment exploration and educational quizzes to make learning more immersive.

The project combines React.js, JavaScript, CSS, and AI-assisted development, with Three.js for 3D visualization and suitable APIs for mission information and AI interactions, where implemented.

TARAK's creativity lies in presenting forgotten space equipment as storytellers rather than simply displaying technical information. By combining scientific information with interactive exploration and storytelling, the project aims to make space science more accessible, engaging, and memorable for younger generations while highlighting the lasting contributions of NASA's missions.
